$comment: US consumer preorders, read by app/lib/us-sales.ts. The US is sold direct only while the PUBLIC_US_SALES gate is "1" in the wrangler config AND rate is a number: the flat US shipping rate in USD that the Shopify US shipping zone charges. null keeps the US closed even with the gate on. Every product sells to the US: a campaign SKU from its first US-serving batch, any other SKU as a preorder of `usStock` in preorders.json. Only Belgian paid stock (batch `regions` in preorders.json) is EU only. Price rule (founder 2026-11-14, one base price before tax, every market adds only what it costs): a US price is the base price (the EUR list price / 1.21) converted at usdPerEur, plus the US duty per unit, to the cent, no rounding: dutyPct[family] + feesPct (merchandise processing and harbor maintenance fees) of the factory price, the customs value under the first-sale rule. Shopify holds it as one fixed USD price per variant on the US price list; fallbackUpliftPct is that list's percentage adjustment, which prices only a variant without a fixed price. Factory prices are supplier prices and never enter this public repository: `npm run us:prices -- --factory <private json>` reads them, compares Shopify with this rule and, with --apply, writes the fixed prices. No US sales tax is collected. Changing a number is a pricing decision that needs the founder's go.
